findings.evidence: All six approved product roles have workflows with prerequisites, steps, expected result, error/recovery, visibility, audit, and requirement/test links.
findings.why_it_matters: Guides must be usable by business users and remain tied to the approved scope.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; verify labels/routes before adding screenshots.

findings.evidence: Installation and support instructions prohibit credentials, tokens, private keys, environment values, and unmasked data; screenshots are marked masked/TBD.
findings.why_it_matters: Release guides are frequently copied into operational channels and must be safe by default.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; apply the same rule to future screenshots/manifests.

findings.evidence: Unavailable screenshots and unresolved client/provider policies are listed as TBD with intended evidence and owners rather than fabricated UI instructions.
findings.why_it_matters: A guide should not promise a screen or recovery action that has not been verified.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; replace TBD entries only after source/UI evidence exists.
